Markets.title: Sebi proposes limiting tenure of chief executives, independent directors at exchanges
Markets.summary: India's markets regulator has proposed stricter governance norms for stock exchanges and market institutions. The draft rules include limiting managing directors to an eight-year tenure, capping directors at two three-year terms, and lowering the public interest director age limit from 75 to 70.

Markets.title: Nasdaq tumbles 2% as Anthropic retreat deepens AI trade concerns
Markets.summary: Anthropic's falling stock price caused the Nasdaq Composite index to drop 2% amid growing investor skepticism toward the AI sector's high valuations and risks. Persistent anxiety over potential Federal Reserve interest rate hikes also added pressure to major U.S. stock indexes.

Markets.title: Nasdaq tumbles over 3% as AI trade concerns spur safe-haven bid: Stock Market Live Updates
Markets.summary: The Nasdaq fell by over 3% as investors grew concerned about artificial intelligence trades. These worries drove a shift toward safe-haven assets in the stock market.

Markets.title: Rupee climbs past 93/USD as investors seek shelter in Indian stocks, shorts unwind
Markets.summary: The Indian rupee strengthened past the 93-per-dollar level for the first time since April, driven by over $12 billion in foreign equity investments in November. This recovery was further supported by hedge funds unwinding bearish positions and stabilization efforts by the Reserve Bank of India.

Markets.title: Anthropic's debut rally fades as shares crack 7% in US pre-market trade
Markets.summary: Anthropic shares dropped up to 7.4% in premarket trading on their second day following a global market selloff and AI sector concerns. This followed an IPO debut where the stock surged 39% before ending its first day 17% higher.

Markets.title: Sharp rupee appreciation may cut IT firms' FY27 earnings by up to 13%: Report
Markets.summary: A recent report indicates that a stronger Indian rupee could reduce Indian IT companies' FY27 earnings by up to 13 percent. This appreciation will significantly impact profitability, particularly for firms with substantial exposure to Europe.

Geo-Political.title: UK to explore even closer ties with EU after agreeing deal, says Burnham
Geo-Political.summary: Following a new agreement on food exports, emissions trading, and youth mobility, Greater Manchester Mayor Andy Burnham stated the UK will explore even closer ties with the EU. The deal marks a significant step in post-Brexit relations between the UK and the European Union.

Geo-Political.title: Russian missile hits Poland as Ukraine's allies hold military exercise, says Tusk
Geo-Political.summary: Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk reported that a Russian missile entered Polish airspace during military exercises held by Ukraine's allies. Warsaw condemned the incident as a Russian provocation, although no injuries or damage occurred.

Geo-Political.title: Russia targets Kyiv crossings days after Ukraine hits Crimean Bridge
Geo-Political.summary: Russia launched a massive air attack targeting crossings in Kyiv. The strikes occurred just days after Ukraine attacked the Crimean Bridge and Russia rejected security guarantees for Ukraine.

Geo-Political.title: Anthropic shares fall after blockbuster opening as wider tech sell-off continues
Geo-Political.summary: Anthropic's stock price declined following its major public market debut. This drop coincided with a broader sell-off that negatively impacted shares of other technology companies amid a general market slump.

Geo-Political.title: Nearly 600 women killed in South Africa within three months
Geo-Political.summary: Nearly 600 women were killed in South Africa over a three-month period. Following this rise in violence, police officials have called for greater efforts to protect women and children.

Geo-Political.title: Texas death-row inmate screams as execution takes more than one hour
Geo-Political.summary: A Texas death-row inmate screamed as his execution lasted over an hour. This prolonged procedure occurred just weeks after Christa Pike survived a lethal injection using the same drug.

AI & Tech.title: REA: The Open-Source AI Tool That Can Reverse Engineer Almost Anything (2026 Guide)
AI & Tech.summary: REA is a new open-source AI tool that allows users to understand how applications work without accessing their source code. The tool eliminates the need for months of learning disassemblers and reading assembly code by providing evidence-backed answers through an AI assistant.

AI & Tech.title: How I Get Free Traffic from ChatGPT in 2025 (AIO vs SEO)
AI & Tech.summary: An online course creator recently discovered their WordPress SaaS course was recommended as the top result when asking ChatGPT for the best course on the topic. The author achieved this visibility without paying for advertising or traditional optimization.

AI & Tech.title: Top 10 AI Tools That Will Transform Your Content Creation in 2025
AI & Tech.summary: This guide highlights the top 10 artificial intelligence tools designed to revolutionize content creation in 2025. These essential technologies help digital creators streamline their workflows and stay competitive in a rapidly evolving landscape.

AI & Tech.summary: LimeWire has evolved into a generative AI platform that allows users to create digital content. The tool also provides features for creators to share and monetize their work.

Data & Insights.title: Undisclosed foreign assets? Taxpayers can declare multiple holdings for  ₹1 lakh
Data & Insights.summary: Taxpayers with undisclosed foreign assets up to ₹5 crore can declare multiple holdings under the FAST-DS scheme. The Central Board of Direct Taxes clarified this option in supplementary FAQs released on Friday.

Data & Insights.title: RBI eases export paperwork for individuals, sets cap for service exporters
Data & Insights.summary: The Reserve Bank of India has simplified export paperwork for individuals. It also established a specific payment cap for service exporters to help banks process overseas transactions more clearly.

Data & Insights.title: ‘Look into wage stagnation’: DEA Secy Anuradha Thakur calls on India Inc to improve employee pay – here’s what she said
Data & Insights.summary: Economic Affairs Secretary Anuradha Thakur urged Indian companies to increase employee pay to help address stagnant wages. She stated that better compensation would boost consumer spending and support overall economic growth.

Data & Insights.title: Govt weighing ways to boost long-term credit to manufacturing: DEA secretary Anuradha Thakur
Data & Insights.summary: The government is exploring methods to increase long-term credit for the manufacturing sector, according to DEA Secretary Anuradha Thakur. She also urged large companies to engage in public-private partnerships, collaborate with smaller businesses, and tackle wage stagnation.

Data & Insights.title: More economic red signals in October—but not everywhere, shows Mint tracker
Data & Insights.summary: India's October economic indicators flashed warning signs, though producer and industrial sectors remained resilient. The second half of the year is expected to be more difficult as the positive effects of previous GST cuts and interest rate reductions diminish.

Data & Insights.title: UK inflation hits one-year high of 3.6%: Why are markets less convinced of another rate hike? | Explained
Data & Insights.summary: UK inflation rose to a one-year high of 3.6% in October due to increased fuel prices and tobacco taxes. Despite this increase, steady core and services inflation reduced market expectations for a December Bank of England rate hike.

India.title: Indian Man Gets Over 19 Years In US Jail Over Plot To Kill Khalistani Terrorist Gurpatwant Pannun
India.summary: Nikhil Gupta pleaded guilty to murder-for-hire charges for plotting to kill Gurpatwant Pannun, a designated terrorist with US and Canadian citizenship, in New York. A US court sentenced the 55-year-old Indian man to over 19 years in prison for the assassination plot.

India.title: Wagging Fingers, Then A Hit To The Head: Uddhav Sena Leader Assaults Civic Official
India.summary: A Shiv Sena (UBT) leader in India allegedly hurled casteist abuse and assaulted a civic official during a meeting. The leader countered that the officer used arrogant and disrespectful language.

India.title: Youth Congress Protest Outside Hyderabad Meta Office Over Account Curbs
India.summary: The Youth Congress protested outside the Hyderabad Meta office after restrictions were placed on their leaders' social media accounts. The curbs specifically affected the handles of national president Uday Bhanu Chib and national in-charge Manish Sharma.

India.title: After Rs 40-Lakh "Children Bank Of India" Con, Gujarat Trader Tricks The Trickster
India.summary: A Gujarati merchant's family was swindled out of 40 lakh rupees using fake "Children Bank of India" toy notes by an inter-state syndicate. The victims then executed a clever counter-sting operation to trick the fraudsters and turn the tables on them.

India.title: In Shock To Ruling BJP, Rajasthan's Villages Give Congress A Big Victory
India.summary: Voters in rural Rajasthan delivered a major victory to the opposition Congress party in the Panchayat Raj elections. Former chief minister Ashok Gehlot stated that the sweeping win sends a clear message that the ruling BJP government's time is up.

India.title: In Flydubai Probe, Search For "Indian Footprints" Of Accused Omani Co-Pilot
India.summary: India's National Investigation Agency is investigating the Indian connections of the Omani co-pilot accused of stabbing Captain Smit Machchhar on a Flydubai flight. The probe aims to uncover any relevant activities or presence the co-pilot had in India.

General.title: UK to explore even closer ties with EU after agreeing deal, says Burnham
General.summary: The UK and EU agreed to a new deal on Friday covering food exports, emissions trading, and a youth experience scheme. Following this agreement, Andy Burnham stated that the UK will explore even closer ties with the EU.

General.title: Faisal Islam: This cost-cutting UK-EU deal doesn't mean lower prices will follow
General.summary: A new post-Brexit UK-EU trade agreement aims to cut regulatory costs and boost the broader economy. However, this deal is not expected to result in lower food prices for shoppers.

General.title: Russian missile hits Poland as Kyiv's allies hold military exercise, says Tusk
General.summary: Nobody was hurt and no damage has been reported, but Warsaw described the incident as a "provocation" from Moscow.

General.title: What we know about the latest Russian missile strikes on Ukraine
General.summary: Russia has launched a new wave of missile strikes targeting various regions and infrastructure across Ukraine. Ukrainian officials are currently assessing the damage and casualties resulting from these latest attacks.

General.title: Daniel Thomas jailed for 15 months for slashing dinghy
General.summary: Anti-migrant activist Daniel Thomas was sentenced to 15 months in prison for slashing a rescue dinghy. The judge described him as a publicity seeker who interfered with the operations of rescue crews.

General.title: Anthropic shares fall after blockbuster opening as wider tech sell-off continues
General.summary: Anthropic's share price declined following its major market debut. This drop occurred amidst a broader downturn affecting other technology companies across the stock market.
